source_caption_text:
6am and I’m already turning up

Moneybagg Yo’s “Time Today” is one of those tracks that immediately grabs your attention. Released in 2021 as the lead single from A Gangsta’s Pain, the song is built around a hard-hitting trap beat and Moneybagg’s confident delivery. From the opening seconds, he makes it clear that he’s not worried about anybody talking about him.

The hook is what really makes the song stick. “I just looked at my wrist, I got time today” became one of those lines that people instantly started using, while Moneybagg spends the rest of the track talking his talk about money, jewelry, success, and the people who stay watching his every move. It’s straightforward, catchy, and exactly the kind of energy that made the song so easy to replay.

The music video added another layer to the whole thing by leaning into the jokes people were making about Moneybagg’s appearance. Instead of ignoring the comparisons, he turned them into part of the video and made the whole situation even funnier. “Time Today” ended up being one of those songs where the music and the internet culture around it worked perfectly together.
